events.title: England and Portugal seal their alliance at Windsor
events.description: The Treaty of Windsor pledged perpetual friendship between the two kingdoms. The Anglo-Portuguese alliance is the oldest diplomatic alliance in the world still in force.
events.html: The Treaty of Windsor pledged perpetual friendship between the two kingdoms. The Anglo-Portuguese alliance is the oldest diplomatic alliance in the world still in force.

events.title: Thomas Blood tries to steal the Crown Jewels
events.description: Disguised as a parson, Thomas Blood and his accomplices overpowered the keeper of the Jewel House and fled with the crown and orb, but were caught. Charles II surprisingly pardoned him.
events.html: Disguised as a parson, Thomas Blood and his accomplices overpowered the keeper of the Jewel House and fled with the crown and orb, but were caught. Charles II surprisingly pardoned him.

events.title: Sniper kills Union general John Sedgwick at Spotsylvania
events.description: Moments after telling his men that Confederate sharpshooters 'couldn't hit an elephant at this distance', General Sedgwick was shot dead. He was the highest-ranking Union officer killed in the war.
events.html: Moments after telling his men that Confederate sharpshooters 'couldn't hit an elephant at this distance', General Sedgwick was shot dead. He was the highest-ranking Union officer killed in the war.

events.title: Byrd and Bennett claim to fly over the North Pole
events.description: Richard Byrd and Floyd Bennett flew a Fokker trimotor from Spitsbergen and reported reaching the Pole. Doubts about their speed and navigation have kept the claim in dispute.
events.html: Richard Byrd and Floyd Bennett flew a Fokker trimotor from Spitsbergen and reported reaching the Pole. Doubts about their speed and navigation have kept the claim in dispute.

events.title: Robert Schuman proposes pooling Europe's coal and steel
events.description: France's foreign minister proposed placing French and German coal and steel under a common authority, making war between them 'materially impossible'. It led to the European Coal and Steel Community.
events.html: France's foreign minister proposed placing French and German coal and steel under a common authority, making war between them 'materially impossible'. It led to the European Coal and Steel Community.

events.title: FDA says it will approve the first contraceptive pill
events.description: The US Food and Drug Administration announced it would license Enovid for contraception. The pill gave women far greater control over fertility and transformed family life.
events.html: The US Food and Drug Administration announced it would license Enovid for contraception. The pill gave women far greater control over fertility and transformed family life.
